_comment: Worked example of a customer overlay (fictitious customer, prefix XX; docs/LINK_REGISTRY.md section 7). Validated with the product layers by tools/link_registry.py --check, never seeded. A custom table ZXX_PAY_REQ (payment requests of the customer's feeder), a custom field ZZXX_REQ_ID appended to the standard items table, the flow request -> items -> payment -> bank line, a fallback chain (partner by external number with the feeder, then without), a standard link switched off (no notification-of-change lots) and one replaced (the customer's bank returns the payment reference without leading zeros).

layer.description: Customer overlay of the example customer XX

objects.description: Payment requests of the feeder (one row per attempt)

fields.name: ZZXX_REQ_ID
fields.description: Custom field: request number on the item

fields.name: ZZXX_FEEDER
fields.description: Custom field: feeder that created the partner

links.description: Request -> partner by member number and feeder
Fallback: partner by member number only (old partners)
Payment -> bank lines (bank drops leading zeros)
